essence: Crossing the ocean of transmigration results in the state of living liberation.
The liberated being appears manifest on earth in a body not born from a womb.
The mantra is defined as a ten-syllable formula beginning with yā and ending with bha.
The mantra’s sage is Kāmadeva and its remaining elements follow the previous pattern.
The figure is known both as Hara’s disciple and as the promoter of the left-hand path.
